name: Orbit
description: Make an object move along an ellipse around a position.

conditions.description: Test if the behavior is enabled.

actions.display-text: Set {my} speed to {0} degrees per second
actions.description: Set the speed the object orbits at.

speed.name: Speed
speed.desc: The new orbit speed, in degrees per second.

actions.description: Target a position in the layout to orbit around.

x.name: X
x.desc: X position of target in layout co-ordinates.

y.name: Y
y.desc: Y position of target in layout co-ordinates.

actions.description: Set the current orbit position by its angle.

angle.name: Angle
angle.desc: New orbit rotation angle, in degrees.

actions.description: Set offset of ellipse angle from axis.

angle.name: Angle
angle.desc: New offset of ellipse angle from axis, in degrees.

actions.description: Set the primary and secondary orbit radii.

primary.name: Primary radius
primary.desc: New primary radius length, in pixels.

secondary.name: Secondary radius
secondary.desc: New secondary radius length, in pixels. (For a circle make the same as primary)

state.name: State
state.desc: Whether to match the rotation of the object to the orbit angle.

actions.description: Set an object as the target location to orbit around.

actions.display-text: Set {my} acceleration to {0} degrees per second per second
actions.description: Set the rate the object's orbital rotation changes.

acceleration.name: Acceleration
acceleration.desc: The new orbit acceleration, in degrees per second per second.

actions.description: Set whether this behavior is enabled.

state.name: State
state.desc: Set whether to enable or disable the behavior.

actions.description: Return the total rotation and total absolute rotation counters to 0

expressions.description: The orbit speed in degrees per second.
The orbit acceleration in degrees per second per second.
The length of the primary radius, in pixels.
The length of the secondary radius, in pixels.
The ellipse offset angle, in degrees.
The current orbit rotation, in degrees.
The current distance to the target position.
The total unclamped rotation so far, in degrees. Value decreases with CCW rotation.
The total unclamped rotation so far, in degrees.

speed.name: Speed
speed.desc: The rotation speed, in degrees per second. Positive is clockwise and negative is anticlockwise.

acceleration.name: Acceleration
acceleration.desc: Rotation acceleration in degrees per second per second (negative slows down).

primary-axis.name: Primary radius
primary-axis.desc: The radius of the orbit along its primary axis.

secondary-axis.name: Secondary radius
secondary-axis.desc: The radius of the orbit along its secondary axis (for a circle use the same as the primary axis).

offset-angle.name: Offset angle
offset-angle.desc: Rotation of the primary axis in degrees.

match-rotation.name: Match rotation
match-rotation.desc: Whether the instance should also rotate, so that it faces the direction of travel.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Whether the behavior is initially enabled or disabled.

live-preview.name: Preview
live-preview.desc: Tick to run a live preview in the editor.
